system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that idempotently configures the firewall on a Linux host: allows SSH (port 22), HTTPS (port 443), and explicitly denies all other inbound traffic.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that idempotently configures the firewall on a Linux host: allows SSH (port 22), HTTPS (port 443), and explicitly denies all other inbound traffic.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Configure Linux firewall
  hosts: all
  become: yes

  tasks:
  - name: Ensure firewalld is installed and enabled
    apt:
      name: firewalld
      state: present
    notify: enable firewalld

  - name: Enable firewalld service
    service:
      name: firewalld
      state: started
      enabled: yes

  - name: Allow SSH traffic
    firewalld:
      service: ssh
      state: enabled
      permanent: yes
      immediate: yes

  - name: Allow HTTPS traffic
    firewalld:
      service: https
      state: enabled
      permanent: yes
      immediate: yes

  - name: Deny all other inbound traffic
    firewalld:
      zone: public
      state: enabled
      permanent: yes
      immediate: yes
    when: ansible_distribution == "CentOS" or ansible_distribution == "RedHat" or ansible_distribution == "Fedora"

  - name: Set default zone to drop
    firewalld:
      zone: public
      set_default: yes
      state: enabled
      permanent: yes
      immediate: yes
    when: ansible_distribution == "Ubuntu" or ansible_distribution == "Debian"

  handlers:
  - name: enable firewalld
    service:
      name: firewalld
      state: started
      enabled: yes
